title: Sign in with an injected test session
Go through onboarding on a new account
goal: May Playground has just signed in to a new account for device test {tag} and shows its first-run onboarding. Go through it to the Chats screen: on Hi, I'm May tap Accept and continue; on the email step and on the phone step tap Not now, never making an address or getting a number; on I have my own computer tap Continue; on Connect your apps tap Not now, never connecting an app; on Make me yours tap Purple, then Continue; on Let me reach you tap Turn on notifications and allow it when the system asks; on I'm all set tap Start chatting. Do not type anything or change a setting. Stop when Chats shows.

title: Chat with May and get a reply
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the existing chat named May; do not use the + button, which makes agents, tasks and projects, not chats. Tap the Ask May field at the bottom. Send this message: This is device test {tag}. Reply with the word received. Then wait until May's reply is posted under your message and the composer shows Speak again.

title: Add a note to a new agenda task
goal: In May Playground, tap the Agenda tab in the bottom bar (not a chat) and add a new task titled {tag} task. Open that task. On its Details tab, tap the notes field that says Add notes and type: {tag} note from the device test. Then go back, open the {tag} task again and check that the note is shown on the {tag} task.

title: Answer May's multiple-choice question
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the existing chat named May; do not use the + button, which makes agents, tasks and projects, not chats. Send this message: Ask me one multiple-choice question about which fruit I would like as a snack, with three choices, tag {tag}. When May shows a question card with choices, tap one of the choices. Then wait until the card shows your choice as the answer.

title: Skip May's question with a free reply
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the existing chat named May; do not use the + button, which makes agents, tasks and projects, not chats. Send this message: Ask me one multiple-choice question about which fruit I would like as a snack, with three choices, tag {tag}. When May shows a question card with choices, do not tap any choice. Instead type and send this message: I will answer myself: apples, {tag}. Then check that the question card now shows as skipped, with its choices dimmed.

title: Make a routine from chat
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the existing chat named May; do not use the + button, which makes agents, tasks and projects, not chats. Send this message: Make a daily routine called {tag} stretch that reminds me to stretch at 9am. When May shows a question card asking whether to create the routine, tap Create it. Then wait until May confirms the routine is made.

title: Harness smoke check: the app starts signed out and the agent can see it
goal: May Playground has just started, signed out. Take one screenshot and read the hierarchy. Do not tap, type, swipe or go back. Then call done with outcome completed, and in the summary name the screen you see.
